Name: Furry Harem Valley
Author: Plebby999
Description:
This conversion is to make [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083]Anthro Characters Continued[/url] Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38552]Harem Valley[/url], an expansion of TrashRacc's 'Valley Girls with more events.

[b]Installation:[/b]
Install all the requirements for ACC and Harem Valley.
Overwrite the portraits and sprites from Harem Valley with this mod.

[b]Credits:[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2417747]Sion9000[/url] and [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/gaveliere.616423/]Gaveliere [/url]for making Anthro Characters Continued.
